text: In nineteen ninety-six, a brand-new rocket broke apart
about forty seconds after launch, because of one number.
Ariane five's guidance software was reused
One value, tied to horizontal velocity,
was a sixty-four-bit float converted into a sixteen-bit integer.
The biggest number that fits is thirty-two thousand, seven hundred sixty-seven.
Ariane five flew faster, the value got too big,
Its backup computer ran the same code,
and had failed the same way moments earlier.
Follow. Tomorrow: sixty F P S that still stutters.
